title: About Us
contentHtml:
Hi, and thank you for checking out our website – Lottery Parakeet is the first lottery bird!


Lottery Parakeet aims to bring you the results and winning numbers for ALL lotteries around the world and in the United States of America. Furthermore, our goal is to bring you those lottery results as soon as possible after the draw takes place.


On top of that our dedicated writers add prize breakdowns, statistics, and game data for every draw in every state, along with the very latest lottery stories and articles.


To contact any of the team, please click here.
